post_topic: Showing Signal: building around a gap no API covers
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A left-to-right horizontal flow diagram with four nodes connected by arrows.

Far left: a rectangular box labeled 'ShowingTime' with the ShowingTime logo. Below the box, a small amber label reads 'No public API. No Zapier.'.

A right-pointing arrow exits the ShowingTime box. Above this arrow, a navy label reads 'Confirmation Email'.

Center-left: a rectangular box labeled 'Showing Signal' in bold navy text. Inside or directly below the box, a small blue label reads 'Reads & parses email'.

A right-pointing arrow exits the Showing Signal box. Above this arrow, a navy label reads 'Structured showing data'.

Center-right: the arrow splits into two downward-angled arrows. Upper arrow points to a box labeled 'CRM' with a blue highlight border and the label 'Auto-logged entry'. Lower arrow points to a box labeled 'Email Sequences' with a blue highlight border and the label 'Triggered automatically'.

Above the entire flow, centered, a title in bold navy reads: 'No API? Build around the email.' Below the title, in smaller text: 'How Showing Signal closes the ShowingTime gap'.

An amber callout bracket or dashed amber box surrounds the space between the ShowingTime node and the Showing Signal node, with a label reading 'The gap — no integration existed'.

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text 'Kelvin Davis' bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
